title: Throwback to Pitti Fragranze 2026: Why it still matters
summary: The 24th edition of Pitti Fragranze, held September 11-13, 2026, at Florence's Stazione Leopolda, Italy, attracted 290 exhibitors and more than 2,200 buyers and industry professionals, according to figures supplied by Pitti Immagine.
